wizard.title: New project
wizard.lede: Describe a topic, ask your questions, declare the sources and the bar. Claimstone checks each step and keeps a draft. Nothing runs until you create the project, and creating it does not start any research.
wizard.signIn: Sign in to create a project.
wizard.advancedActive: Advanced edits are active: changes in steps 1 to 3 may not appear in the generated files. Reset them in step 4 to generate the files again.
wizard.lastFailure: The last attempt to create the project was refused:

expired.text: Your session ended. Sign in in another tab, then press the button below and save again. What you typed is still here.
expired.recheck: I have signed in: check again

wizard.draftNote: Draft saved · nothing runs until you create the project
wizard.discarded: This draft was discarded. Nothing was created.

1.name: Topic
1.hint: what you need to know, and why

2.name: Questions
2.hint: literature questions get a verdict you sign

3.name: Sources and rigour
3.hint: where evidence may come from, and the bar

kind.effect: effect — judged on results that test it: estimates, uncertainty, horizon, sample, design.
kind.heterogeneity: heterogeneity — judged on the contrast between subgroups, with its uncertainty and whether the subgroup analysis was prespecified.
kind.method: method — judged on what kind of support each source gives the methodological claim.
kind.premise: premise — judged on the explicit statement of it, or a contradiction of it.
kind.operational: operational — tracked in this project; no literature verdict applies, and it is never shown as awaiting your signature.

step1.title: 1 · The topic
step1.intro: Name the project and list what to search for. Terms are broad on purpose: their job is to find works, not to define what is learned.
step1.name: Project name
step1.nameHelp: 2 to 63 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. It becomes the folder name and cannot be changed.
step1.description: What you need to know, and why (optional)
step1.descriptionHelp: In scope and out of scope, in a few sentences. It is kept with the project and read by no stage.
step1.termsHelp: Each term is searched as written.
step1.afterSave: Claimstone checks the name and the topics, then keeps a draft. Nothing is created and nothing runs.
step1.atCreation: Each search term will become one query on each index you choose later. So far: {terms} terms in {topics} topics, which means {searches} searches per index, or {searchesAll} if all three indexes are used.
step1.afterStart: Terms find works; they do not define what is learned. Widening a topic is cheap and cannot by itself change a verdict.

step2.title: 2 · The questions
step2.intro: Write each literature question as a statement the literature can support or contradict. Claimstone does not judge your wording: it only checks that a question is not empty and has a kind.
step2.question: Question
step2.afterSave: Claimstone checks each question and keeps a draft. The questions are not frozen yet, so you can still change them.
step2.atCreation: The question registry is frozen at version 1, dated today. {literature} of your {total} questions are literature questions: each will get an evidence profile that a person reads and signs. {operational} are operational: tracked, but they never receive a verdict. Changing the registry later is a dated version bump, never a silent edit.
step2.afterStart: Each kind is judged by its own rule. Claimstone reads sources with these questions in mind and extracts claims, each bound to a verbatim quote that code checks.

step3.title: 3 · Sources and rigour
step3.intro: Declare which kinds of source may count and the bar a round must clear before it can conclude anything. These are declared now and recorded with today's date.
step3.classesHelp: Every source carries its class, and classes are never mixed silently. Choose at least one.
step3.floorHelp: The share of found works that must be obtained as confirmed copies. Between 0 and 1.
step3.rationaleHelp: At least 20 characters. A bar without a reason is a bar somebody can move.
step3.suppliedCount: Count toward the floor once verified
step3.suppliedSeparate: Read them, but report them separately from the floor

suppliedValue.count: count — counted toward the floor once verified
suppliedValue.separate: separate — read, but reported apart from the floor

step3.suppliedHelp: Declared now, before any copy exists. It cannot change under this protocol.
step3.notation: How this field writes its figures
step3.customLabelsHelp: For example the abbreviations a paper writes next to a number.
step3.hosts: Hosts never to contact, besides the standing list
step3.hostsHelp: One bare host name per line, with no scheme, path or wildcard.
step3.afterSave: Claimstone checks the classes, the floor and its reason, and keeps a draft.
step3.atCreation: The floor {floor} is written with today's date and your reason, and it has no override. Every source will carry one of {classes} classes. Excluded hosts are never contacted ({added} added by you). Copies you supply: {supplied}.
step3.afterStart: After the search, Claimstone counts how many of the works it found it could obtain as confirmed copies. Below the floor it reports INSUFFICIENT_ACQUISITION and produces no verdicts at all: a corpus read at 42% that certifies itself complete is worse than no corpus.

step4.title: 4 · Review and create
step4.intro: This is exactly what will be created. Check it, then confirm.
step4.summary: Project {name}: {topics} topics, {total} questions ({literature} literature, {operational} operational), {classes} source classes, floor {floor}.
step4.needSteps: Steps 1 to 3 must be saved before you can review the project.
step4.files: The files that will be created
step4.digest: Protocol fingerprint (sha256): what you see is what is created
step4.advancedHelp: An edit replaces a whole file and must still load with the same checks. If you change an earlier step after editing here, reset the files so they are generated again.
step4.resetHelp: If you edited the files and the date has changed, reset them so they are generated again.
step4.unsaved: You have unsaved file changes: save or discard them first.
step4.confirm: I understand that the question registry and the floor are frozen at version 1 on {frozenAt} (UTC date), and that changing them later needs a dated new version.
step4.startNote: Not available yet: authorizing and starting research comes with the next stage of the portal.
step4.notStarted: Creating the project starts no search, no copy request and no model call, and spends nothing.
step4.privacy: The project is created in the projects/ folder, which Git ignores: it stays on this machine and is not published.
step4.next1: You authorize one exact plan: the searches, the copy requests and any paid model work, up to a cap you set.
step4.next2: Claimstone searches the indexes and obtains legal copies, recording every attempt.
step4.next3: It prepares the documents, extracts claims bound to verbatim quotes, and a different model reviews each one.
step4.next4: It builds an evidence profile for each literature question.
step4.next5: A person reads each profile and signs a verdict. Nothing is signed for you.
step4.afterSave: There is nothing to save here: the draft is complete once steps 1 to 3 are saved. Creating the project is the one action on this page.
step4.atCreation: Claimstone writes three files under projects/{name}/, freezes the question registry and the floor at version 1 on {frozenAt} (UTC date), and records each file's hash. It starts nothing.
step4.afterStart: You will authorize one exact plan. Claimstone then searches, obtains legal copies, prepares the documents, extracts claims bound to verbatim quotes, has a different model review each one, and builds an evidence profile per literature question. A person reads it and signs. This stage of the portal does not do any of that yet.

created.title: Project created
created.body: The project {name} now exists, frozen at version 1 on {frozenAt} (UTC date). Nothing has started.
created.bodyUndated: The project {name} now exists, frozen at version 1. Nothing has started.

errors.VALIDATION: Some of what you entered cannot be accepted.
errors.STALE_REVISION: This draft was changed elsewhere. Reload it to see the latest version.
errors.DRAFT_CLOSED: This draft is closed: it was discarded or already turned into a project, so it can no longer be changed.
errors.PREVIEW_CHANGED: The draft changed after you opened this review, so what you confirmed is no longer what would be created. Reload to review the current version.
errors.NAME_TAKEN: A project with this name already exists. Go back to step 1 and choose another name.
errors.INCOMPLETE: The draft is not complete yet: steps 1 to 3 must all be saved first.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has ended. Sign in again, then repeat the action.
